front.title: Oracle Confidence Gating: G-Score, Correlation-Aware von Neumann Confidence, and AdaptiveSwitch

abstract.t: This document specifies an optional confidence layer for the TLS TimeToken Secure Protocol (TTTPS). It defines the G-Score, a normalized entropy measure of agreement concentration; an optional correlation-aware von Neumann extension; the InsufficientKnowledge signal; and the AdaptiveSwitch state machine over TURBO and FULL. The confidence layer qualifies whether evidence justifies action. It does not replace cryptographic integrity, define a wire format, allocate a codepoint, establish source independence, or require any core TTTPS implementation to compute confidence.
